newsitem.title: USA: Criticare gets FDA nod to sell system.
newsitem.headline: Criticare gets FDA nod to sell system.

text.p: Criticare Systems Inc said on Friday it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to sell its MPT (Multiple Parameter Telemetry) patient monitoring system.
"Criticare is the first company to miniaturize a conventional patient monitor measuring ECG, blood pressure, heart rate and oxygen saturation to the size of a portable radio," the company said.
"MPT is the world's first monitor to be patient borne with a bi-directional telemetry link to a central station," it added.
"Two years and significant capital have been invested in the design, manufacturing and marketing of this revolutionary product," said Chief Executive Officer Gerhard Von der Ruhr in a statement.
Criticare designs, manufactures and markets patient monitoring systems and non-invasive sensors.
